title: What Happens When Space Junk Collides? | Horizon: Space Junk | Earth Science
speaker: BBC Earth Science
zh: 【BBC Earth Science】太空垃圾碰撞時會發生什麼事？ |地平線：太空垃圾 |地球科學（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: People tend to think of orbit like a road through space.
cues.en: People tend to think of orbit like a road through space.
cues.zh: 人們傾向於將軌道視為穿越太空的道路。

cues.text: As long as you stay on your road, you're not going to get hit.
cues.en: As long as you stay on your road, you're not going to get hit.
cues.zh: 只要你繼續在路上，你就不會被擊中。

cues.text: It would be more accurate to think of the Earth
cues.en: It would be more accurate to think of the Earth
cues.zh: 想想地球會更準確

cues.text: as being one big paved planet.
cues.en: as being one big paved planet.
cues.zh: 作為一顆巨大的鋪砌星球。

cues.text: And when you want to go someplace,
cues.en: And when you want to go someplace,
cues.zh: 而當你想去某個地方時，

cues.text: you drive in a straight line from one place to another,
cues.en: you drive in a straight line from one place to another,
cues.zh: 你沿著一條直線從一個地方開車到另一個地方

cues.text: and of course with no stoplights and no place to stop,
cues.en: and of course with no stoplights and no place to stop,
cues.zh: 當然，沒有紅綠燈，也沒有地方停車，

cues.text: and you're going to be running into each other
cues.en: and you're going to be running into each other
cues.zh: 你們將會遇到彼此

cues.text: all kinds of directions.
cues.en: all kinds of directions.
cues.zh: 各種方向。

cues.text: That's exactly what you got in orbit.
cues.en: That's exactly what you got in orbit.
cues.zh: 這正是你在軌道上得到的。

cues.text: So I ended up with an equation where I could write
cues.en: So I ended up with an equation where I could write
cues.zh: 所以我最後得到了一個可以寫的方程

cues.text: the spatial density, its apogee, and inclination.
cues.en: the spatial density, its apogee, and inclination.
cues.zh: 空間密度、最高點和傾角。

cues.text: Then you can do neat things like...
cues.en: Then you can do neat things like...
cues.zh: 然後你可以做一些巧妙的事情，例如...

cues.text: His calculations predicted that if bits of junk
cues.en: His calculations predicted that if bits of junk
cues.zh: 他的計算預測，如果一些垃圾

cues.text: started smashing into each other at such huge speeds...
cues.en: started smashing into each other at such huge speeds...
cues.zh: 開始以如此巨大的速度互相撞擊…

cues.text: If you want to know the flux, the spatial density...
cues.en: If you want to know the flux, the spatial density...
cues.zh: 如果你想知道通量、空間密度...

cues.text: They'd create a cascade of collisions
cues.en: They'd create a cascade of collisions
cues.zh: 他們會造成一連串的碰撞

cues.text: that would litter orbits with dangerous debris.
cues.en: that would litter orbits with dangerous debris.
cues.zh: 這會在軌道上散落危險的碎片。

cues.text: The integral of S squared...
cues.en: The integral of S squared...
cues.zh: S 平方的積分...

cues.text: This became known as the Kessler syndrome.
cues.en: This became known as the Kessler syndrome.
cues.zh: 這被稱為凱斯勒綜合症。

cues.text: Integrated over the volume.
cues.en: Integrated over the volume.
cues.zh: 整合在體積上。

cues.text: In other words, if you never launch anything else in space,
cues.en: In other words, if you never launch anything else in space,
cues.zh: 換句話說，如果你從未在太空中發射任何其他東西，

cues.text: there will still be this cascading phenomena
cues.en: there will still be this cascading phenomena
cues.zh: 仍然會出現這種級聯現象

cues.text: that continues to grow and actually continues
cues.en: that continues to grow and actually continues
cues.zh: 持續成長並且實際上持續

cues.text: until you essentially grind up all the satellites
cues.en: until you essentially grind up all the satellites
cues.zh: 直到你基本上碾碎所有衛星

cues.text: and the small dust particles.
cues.en: and the small dust particles.
cues.zh: 和小灰塵顆粒。
